problems.reason: Sentence 1 states Aviatyrannis could be a tyrannosauroid or an ornithomimosaurian, while sentences 12–14 unambiguously place it within Tyrannosauroidea, presenting conflicting classifications without acknowledging the uncertainty.

notes: - contradiction: "Aviatyrannis is a small coelurosaurian theropod dinosaur from the Late Jurassic of Portugal that is classified as either a tyrannosauroid or an ornithomimosaurian." / "Rauhut placed Aviatyrannis in the Tyrannosauroidea in a basal position in 2003." / "The time range for Aviatyrannis is the Kimmeridgian stage, from 154.8 to 149.2 million years ago." / "If classified as a tyrannosauroid, Aviatyrannis is one of the oldest known members of that group, potentially older than Proceratosaurus.": Sentence 1 states Aviatyrannis could be a tyrannosauroid or an ornithomimosaurian, while sentences 12–14 unambiguously place it within Tyrannosauroidea, presenting conflicting classifications without acknowledging the uncertainty.
